source_text: At least I’m admitting I need a gun.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.At least I’m admitting I need a gun.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.At least I’m admitting I need a gun."

translation: Przynajmniej przyznaję, że potrzebuję broni.

source_text: Come to the station.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Come to the station.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Come to the station."

translation: Przyjedź na posterunek.

source_text: Can you even kill a demon with a gun?... At least I’ll be protected a bit from Duncan’s goons.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Can you even kill a demon with a gun?... At least I’ll be protected a bit from Duncan’s goons.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Can you even kill a demon with a gun?... At least I’ll be protected a bit from Duncan’s goons."

translation: Czy w ogóle da się zabić demona pistoletem?... Przynajmniej trochę ochroni mnie przed ludźmi Duncana.

source_text: You’re falling into sin, 1Hero!

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.You’re falling into sin, 1Hero!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.You’re falling into sin, 1Hero!"

translation: Pogrążasz się w grzechu, 1Hero!

source_text: I feel fine, Arianna. Stop complaining.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I feel fine, Arianna. Stop complaining.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I feel fine, Arianna. Stop complaining."

translation: Nic mi nie jest, Arianno. Przestań narzekać.

source_text: I’m not complaining… I’m here to help you.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.I’m not complaining… I’m here to help you.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.I’m not complaining… I’m here to help you."

translation: Nie narzekam… Jestem tu, żeby ci pomóc.

source_text: What if we have this all wrong… What if there is a way to save the souls in Hell?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What if we have this all wrong… What if there is a way to save the souls in Hell?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What if we have this all wrong… What if there is a way to save the souls in Hell?"

translation: A jeśli wszystko źle rozumiemy… A jeśli da się ocalić dusze w piekle?

source_text: Once you’re damned to Hell, there’s no coming back.

structure.raw_value: ArAnEx.Once you’re damned to Hell, there’s no coming back.
structure.script_literal: "ArAnEx.Once you’re damned to Hell, there’s no coming back."

translation: Kiedy trafisz do piekła, nie ma już powrotu.

source_text: But you’re wrong. There is the rift under the mansion. People could go through that.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.But you’re wrong. There is the rift under the mansion. People could go through that.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.But you’re wrong. There is the rift under the mansion. People could go through that."

translation: Ale się mylisz. Pod rezydencją jest rozdarcie. Ludzie mogą przez nie przejść.

source_text: That’s not how it works… Nothing can leave Hell.

structure.raw_value: ArAnEx.That’s not how it works… Nothing can leave Hell.
structure.script_literal: "ArAnEx.That’s not how it works… Nothing can leave Hell."

translation: To tak nie działa… Nic nie może opuścić piekła.

source_text: I did… So did Lillian and Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I did… So did Lillian and Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I did… So did Lillian and Madalyn."

translation: A jednak mi się udało… Lillian i Madalyn też.

source_text: If you enter Hell in your Earthly body, you can leave… But nothing damned to Hell can leave.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.If you enter Hell in your Earthly body, you can leave… But nothing damned to Hell can leave.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.If you enter Hell in your Earthly body, you can leave… But nothing damned to Hell can leave."

translation: Jeśli wejdziesz do piekła w swoim ziemskim ciele, możesz z niego wyjść… Ale potępieni nie mogą go opuścić.

source_text: So Lillian and Madalyn are not damned to Hell?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So Lillian and Madalyn are not damned to Hell?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So Lillian and Madalyn are not damned to Hell?"

translation: Czyli Lillian i Madalyn nie są potępione?

source_text: You need to die first! Don’t you know anything?

structure.raw_value: ArAnEx.You need to die first! Don’t you know anything?
structure.script_literal: "ArAnEx.You need to die first! Don’t you know anything?"

translation: Najpierw musisz umrzeć! Niczego nie wiesz?

source_text: Explain it to me like I’m five.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Explain it to me like I’m five.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Explain it to me like I’m five."

translation: Wytłumacz mi to tak, jakbym miał pięć lat.

source_text: In life, you have the chance to obey God or otherwise be damned in death.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.In life, you have the chance to obey God or otherwise be damned in death.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.In life, you have the chance to obey God or otherwise be damned in death."

translation: Za życia możesz być posłuszny Bogu. Jeśli nie, po śmierci trafisz do piekła.

source_text: So if I kill Madalyn, she’ll be unable to leave Hell?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So if I kill Madalyn, she’ll be unable to leave Hell?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So if I kill Madalyn, she’ll be unable to leave Hell?"

translation: Czyli jeśli zabiję Madalyn, nie będzie mogła opuścić piekła?

source_text: The woman you call Madalyn has no soul. If she dies, she ceases to exist… She doesn’t go anywhere.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.The woman you call Madalyn has no soul. If she dies, she ceases to exist… She doesn’t go anywhere.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.The woman you call Madalyn has no soul. If she dies, she ceases to exist… She doesn’t go anywhere."

translation: Kobieta, którą nazywasz Madalyn, nie ma duszy. Jeśli umrze, przestanie istnieć… Nigdzie nie trafi.

source_text: This is so confusing.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.This is so confusing.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.This is so confusing."

translation: To takie zagmatwane.

source_text: Oh, brother! This is hurting my head.

structure.raw_value: ArAnOp.Oh, brother! This is hurting my head.
structure.script_literal: "ArAnOp.Oh, brother! This is hurting my head."

translation: O rany! Rozboli mnie od tego głowa.

source_text: It’s hurting your head? You’re the one hurting my head!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It’s hurting your head? You’re the one hurting my head!
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It’s hurting your head? You’re the one hurting my head!"

translation: Ciebie od tego boli głowa? To ty mnie przyprawiasz o ból głowy!

source_text: You don’t need to understand, you only need to obey.

structure.raw_value: ArAnDe.You don’t need to understand, you only need to obey.
structure.script_literal: "ArAnDe.You don’t need to understand, you only need to obey."

translation: Nie musisz rozumieć. Masz tylko być posłuszny.
